title: Admissible test m-form whose exterior derivative on the face is the divergence of g
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let p = (ι, b) be an index pair with ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing. Let N ⊆ ℝ^P be open with Φ_p(y) ∈ N for all y ∈ Q₁ = (0,1)ⁿ, where Φ_p(y) = b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} and e_l = EuclideanSpace.single l 1. Let g : Euclid n → Euclid n be C^∞ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and ‖g‖ ≤ 1. Then there is a test m-form γ on ℝ^P (γ ∈ TestFormOn univ m) with tsupport γ ⊆ N and covectorEuclideanNorm(γ(x)) ≤ 1 for all x, such that dγ(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) = trace(Dg(y)) for every y ∈ Q₁. Here dγ = exteriorDerivative γ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (p : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), StrictMono p.1 → IsOpen N → (∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ N) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ N ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → exteriorDerivative (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y)
